    Gabriel push-down as a functor on linear modules #

    The objectwise direct-sum module constructed in OrbitPushdown is natural in the upstairs module. This file sends a module natural transformation diagonally across the translated summands, proves naturality for arbitrary orbit morphisms, and bundles the construction as an additive linear functor between linear-module categories.
